item.title: Show HN: Telnet Hackerlinks.com
item.summary: A simple, retro telnet chat. Thought of this as a distraction free alternative for real-time conversations for folks with a terminal. Feel free to join, create own rooms and message people. Enter with "telnet hackerlinks.com". Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49409229 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
